styles.name: qubit-superposition
styles.description: Qubit |0⟩↔|1⟩ superposition: state oscillates, collapses to |1⟩ as progress reaches 100%

styles.name: bloch-sphere
styles.description: Bloch sphere: wireframe sphere + state vector precessing with time, polar angle from progress

styles.name: wavefunction-collapse
styles.description: Wavefunction collapse: |ψ(x)|² spreads as a broad Gaussian then sharpens to a spike at 100%

styles.name: quantum-tunneling
styles.description: Quantum tunneling: wave packet hits a barrier, transmitted amplitude grows with progress

styles.name: harmonic-oscillator
styles.description: QHO eigenstate: |ψₙ|² density plotted — energy level n steps up the ladder with progress

styles.name: particle-in-box
styles.description: Particle in a box: sin²(nπx/L) standing mode — mode n steps up with progress, walls visible

styles.name: spin-precession
styles.description: Spin precession: Larmor cone — polar tilt from progress, azimuth rotates with time

styles.name: energy-levels
styles.description: Energy level diagram: Aufbau filling — electrons populate orbitals from bottom as progress rises

styles.name: decoherence
styles.description: Decoherence: sharp interference fringes wash out to flat noise as entanglement grows

styles.name: quantum-walk
styles.description: Quantum random walk: bimodal spreading distribution — spreads linearly (not √n) with progress
